document.excerpt: In brief Zcash full node developer Zakura has proposed "one-time" viewing keys to stop a future quantum computer from linking a user's shielded Zcash payments. The fix targets swaps through NEAR Intents, in which the user’s shielded address is posted on NEAR’s public chain. Wallets built on Zakura's open-source libraries, such as Vizor, will be able to add the feature in the coming weeks, with hardware wallets to follow.
